objective: Propose the Jin Notes CM6 full-pane SOURCE EDITOR spec (Wave-2 Track B v2) — REPLACING the per-block inline-textarea editor (the killed anti-pattern from spec 9a893cc6/2026-06-28-track-b-editor) with ONE continuous CodeMirror 6 surface (one caret, one buffer). FRONTEND-ONLY (jin-gui); zero Rust/Tauri/schema. THIS pass = source editor: markdown + syntax highlighting (hand-rolled HighlightStyle), NOT full live-preview (compartment-ready fast-follow). Raw markdown stays on-disk source of truth (CM6 edits plain text). Reading-view toggle renders ONLY through the existing sanitize chokepoint renderMarkdownFragment (markdown.ts:60).
